title: Castelion lines
description: Text set line by line, each line in its own mask: as the text scrolls into view every line slides up out of its mask one after another (or, in the fade variant, rises 28px and fades in). Lines flow together on phones and break where you split them on desktop.
notes: pure CSS scroll-driven animation (view timeline); browsers without it, and reduced motion, show the text in place
each entry of `lines` is one desktop line; on phones the entries flow and wrap freely
name: castelion-lines

props.name: lines
props.description: the text, one entry per desktop line (phones let the entries flow and wrap)

props.name: as
props.description: the element to render, e.g. "h2" or "p"

props.name: variant
props.description: mask: each line slides up out of a clip (titles) · fade: each line rises 28px and fades in (copy)

props.name: startIndex
props.description: where the stagger starts counting, to continue it from text above
